name: v08-a-play

checks.id: K1 the key card shows on the ground with the game keys and "press a flying key to take off"

detail.title: Keyboard · easy play
detail.now: Press a flying key to take off

checks.id: K2 the up arrow starts the motors (no Space) and climbs at about 2.5 m/s
K9 K over the ground card hides it, and it does not come back over the flight; control: the card was up on the ground before K (K1)
K3 keys released: the height holds (altitude help)
K4 W tilts the drone forward about 25 deg and the height holds through it
K5 in the air the card goes; K shows it, K again hides it
K10 Esc pauses while Shift is held as the boost with W (and Esc resumes); control: Shift alone is the modifier, Shift+Esc pauses nothing
K6 the school chip counts toward 30 s; the goal offers step 2, which switches the altitude help off
K7 without the help the arrows move a throttle that stays where it is left (it took over from the help without a jump)
S1 the motor sound is 15 % by default; the speaker on the top bar mutes and unmutes it
K11 Space: a tap in the air keeps the drone flying and its height; held 0.8 s it stops the motors (control)
K12 the easy-play flight (auto-arm, altitude help, Space) replays from its log to the same hash; controls: one LSB and a 0.05 stick twitch in one record change it
K8 no page errors
K-control the pilot profile: the same key does not start the motors, its card is the Mode 2 one
T1-tablet easy play: no ARM button, the hint says what the sticks do, "touch a stick to take off"

detail.hint: Left stick: up / down and turn. Right stick: fly.
detail.gate: Touch a stick to take off

checks.id: T2-tablet a touch-down off-centre moves no stick; control: v0.7's absolute pad read it as a deflection
T3-tablet a touch starts the motors; the left stick at 60 % climbs about 1.5 m/s; released, it springs to centre
T4-tablet the height holds with no finger on the sticks

T5-tablet the right stick at half forward tilts the drone (angle mode); a touch sample reaches the flight at the frame measured for pointermove and for pointerrawupdate (100 % the same frame); control: a sample held to the next animation frame is measured a frame later
T10-tablet from a touch-down on the pad's outer rim the screen's edge is full stick (roll and pitch back); control: the first grab reached 0.256 / -0.256
T6-tablet the pilot school chip is on screen
T9-tablet the speaker is on screen and nothing at the top prints over anything else; controls: the school chip moved onto the buttons, and onto the credit's text, is caught
T7-tablet no scroll or zoom from the touches
T11-tablet the touch flight (auto-arm, altitude help, grab) replays from its log to the same hash; controls: one LSB and a 0.05 stick twitch in one record change it
T8-tablet no page errors
